key_insight: An H₂-optimal design framework identifies riblet wall-normal profiles that maximally suppress modeled turbulent velocity fluctuations at a fixed spanwise spacing.
engineering_relevance: Systematic riblet-shape optimization could guide drag-reducing surface design without exhaustive searches over predefined geometries.
method: Model riblets using volume penalization in linearized Navier–Stokes dynamics.
Recast penalization as structured state feedback.
Minimize steady-state fluctuation variance and riblet-induced dynamical augmentations while maintaining constant bulk flux.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports optimal profiles for fixed riblet spacing but provides no quantitative attenuation results or experimental validation.
watch_item: Suppression in the linearized model does not by itself establish drag reduction in fully nonlinear turbulent flows.
paper_title: $H_2$-optimal riblet profiles for turbulence suppression in channel flows
